name: Being Judgmental
overview: Scripture teaches that while believers are called to warn the wicked of their sin, they must exercise judgment with humility and righteousness. Jesus instructs us not to judge others harshly or hypocritically, reminding us that the measure we use will be measured back to us. True judgment requires discerning rightly rather than condemning based on appearances, and recognizing that condemning others while committing the same sins brings self-condemnation. Forgiveness and mercy are essential attitudes alongside righteous judgment.
